dedupe_keys.name: phailin tweets social media during cyclone phailin with user level metrics and annotated subset

description: This dataset collects 58,261 tweets about Cyclone Phailin, the severe cyclone that struck Odisha on India's east coast in October 2013, gathered through the Twitter Academic API. It was deposited on Mendeley Data by Swarnalakshmi Umamaheswaran and Anuradha Goswami; version 2 was published in 2026. Besides the raw tweets it has a processed user-level table with derived metrics such as a spread score and a focus rate for studying how information spreads, and 1,500 manually annotated tweets labelled by user type, such as government, non-governmental organisation, media or citizen, and by content category, which the authors used to train a few-shot classifier with a recall of 0.72. Coverage is one event in India. The files are free to download under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: sharing of tweet text is subject to the platform's terms, the collection covers only what the API returned, and file formats are not stated in the metadata. Simulation uses: communication patterns among responders and citizens for emergency information spread and warning models in South Asia. Related records: CrisisNLP (data-crisisnlp-crisis-informatics-datasets) and CREXWET (data-crexdata-crexwet-weather-emergency-tweets) are larger multi-event tweet collections.
